analysis: Examined docs/provider/cli-reference.md head lines 1-830. The complete range map shows two changes. Head line 3 bumps the 'Last updated' date. Head line 1741, outside the supplied units but visible in the patch excerpt, adds an environment-variable row: DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED, read in libs/mlx-swift-lm/Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/GatedDelta.swift (GatedDeltaPrefill.mode), where `0` keeps the stock Qwen GDN prompt kernel. This is documentation of a performance kernel toggle. It does not change attestation, the authorization contract (TB-011, T-052..T-058), the encryption or response path (T-008), the prefix-cache gate or TTL (T-041/SEC-035), or logout/token custody (A-008, T-053). The surrounding unchanged text on logout, cache, switch and GLM is pre-existing and is not attributed to this PR. One question is left for review of the code change, which is outside this batch. If the new GDN blocked prefill kernel is default-on, it could affect inference correctness (T-007/T-027 class) or memory safety and availability on decrypted prompt data (TB-007). Reviewers should confirm whether the env name or the kernel feeds into the KV-cache layout or epoch bindings, since SSD checkpoints bind layoutEpoch. Doc-only evidence shows no security regression.
